#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page titled 'Annual Financial Report' with the current date
to report.pdf using the pdf skill."""

import datetime

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"

reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
page_count = len(reader.pages)
print(f"pdf pages in {INPUT_PDF}: {page_count}")

first_page = reader.pages[0]
try:
    width = float(first_page.mediabox.width)
    height = float(first_page.mediabox.height)
except Exception:
    width, height = letter
print(f"page size: {width} x {height} points")

today = datetime.date.today()
date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"current date: {date_str}")

cover_pdf = "cover_page.pdf"
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_pdf, pagesize=(width, height))

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
title = "Annual Financial Report"
tw = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawString((width - tw) / 2, height * 0.62, title)

c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
dw = c.stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 18)
c.drawString((width - dw) / 2, height * 0.52, date_str)

c.save()
print(f"created {cover_pdf}")

cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_pdf)
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as out_f:
    writer.write(out_f)

print(f"wrote {OUTPUT_PDF} with {len(writer.pages)} pages")

check = PdfReader(OUTPUT_PDF)
print(f"verification: {OUTPUT_PDF} has {len(check.pages)} pages")
print("cover text:", repr((check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()))
PYEOF
echo "script written: pdf report.pdf Annual Financial Report"
